dataset_notes.boundary_labels: only 3 of 2352 Fit molecules sit on a reported clipping boundary (4.5); no -1.5 boundary labels
dataset_notes.duplicate_structure_conflicts: morgan_radius2_2048bit collisions are recorded; identical encodings with different labels bound the achievable RMSE for any representation built only from the frozen graph
dataset_notes.formal_charge_coverage: 2351 of 2352 Fit molecules are neutral and the single charged molecule is in the Fold-1 train split, so the formal-charge subgroup is empty on dev and cannot be evaluated in this round
dataset_notes.label_semantics: the frozen LCRC lipophilicity label is the octanol/water distribution coefficient logD; there is no separate experimental logP column in the frozen artifacts
dataset_notes.logd_minus_mollogp: label_minus_mol_logp is therefore literally logD - RDKit Crippen MolLogP computed on the frozen heavy-atom graph; it is a descriptive chemistry offset, not a model input

interpretation_guard: descriptive only: these numbers rank error concentration on the frozen A-R3 dev residuals; they do not select a model or alter any pre-registered threshold

scope.labels_source: frozen Fit-only label artifact (phase1a labels_fit_monitor, fit values only)
